<!-- pr-reviewer: 868da45d50b82e9c5672511e41cd6feb88abfaf3 -->
**Needs changes before merge** - the code reviews clean, but the branch no longer merges with `main` (two trivial UI conflicts).

**What looks good**
- Entries are a separate `ProgramEntry` component, so `operation_order` and every walk built on it skip them with no per-walk carve-outs; entries post through a single hook (`posting::op_streams`) and are pinned byte-identical to the per-op after-actions.
- Refusals are by name (entry before every posted op, Pause and Home in one gap, Tormach); all changes are undoable commands (`AddProgramEntry`, `EditProgramEntry`, reused `ReorderOperation` / `DeleteEntity`).
- Project file: documents without entries write no new key, and an older reader refuses a file with entries instead of dropping stops. No `build.rs`, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes. Provenance lines present, new files all under 400 lines, `docs/decisions/155-pause-home-entries.md` present, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit, body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #155`.
- No `unwrap` / `expect` / `panic!` outside test code in the diff.

**Local results (PR head 868da45, not merged with main - see below)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| `camcraft-app --test program_entry` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib program_entry` (from `crates/ui`) | 3 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The contributor's hands-on and posted-Fanuc checks (PR comment) are noted; not repeated here.

**Requested before merge**
1. Refresh the branch with `git merge origin/main`. Trial merge against current `main` (caa4eff3) conflicts in two UI files, both keep-both-sides:
   - `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (~line 37-50): keep `state_program_entry` (`mod program_entry; pub use program_entry::EntryVerb;`) together with main's new `state_tool_library` / `state_tool_body` modules and the `tool_body_ui` re-export.
   - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` (~line 92-100): keep both `mod program_entry;` and main's `mod tool_body;`.
   Then re-run the `program_entry` suites (app and ui) on the merged tree and re-flag ready.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- A trailing Go home entry homes twice; already filed as #504.
- Snapshot or GPU-dependent ui tests were not part of this run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7c917f881a1edfa1995ff9f1e1670a22e5962eea -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This head is the merge with main that the previous review asked for. It trial-merges cleanly with `upstream/main` (no conflicts).

**What looks good**
- `ProgramEntry` is not an `Operation`, so every `operation_order` walk skips entries without per-walk carve-outs.
- Posting folds each entry into the preceding op's `AfterOperation` word through one hook. Gap conflicts and Tormach are refused by name.
- All edits are undoable commands (`AddProgramEntry`, `EditProgramEntry`, reused `ReorderOperation` and `DeleteEntity`).
- Documents without entries save byte-identically. An older reader refuses a file that has entries instead of dropping the stops.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the new modules. Each new module has a provenance line and is under 400 lines. The component sits in `schema.rs`. No `build.rs`, `.github`, scripts or dependency changes. No `CHANGELOG.md` edits. The body has a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #155`. The decision file is `docs/decisions/155-pause-home-entries.md`.

**Local results (merged with main, macOS)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| app `program_entry` | 7 passed |
| app `project_roundtrip` | 69 passed |
| app `posting` | 17 passed |
| app `setups`, `setup_sheet` | 7 and 11 passed |
| app `--lib` | 101 passed |
| ui `--lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 353 passed, 3 failed, 5 ignored |
| ui `--lib program_entry` | 3 passed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

The 3 ui failures are `headless_run_succeeds`, `shell_structure_dark` and `shell_structure_light`. All three need a GPU, and this Mac has no adapter. That is an environment artifact, not a defect in the PR.
```
egui headless run failed: No suitable graphics adapter found
```

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Entries add a new `"kind": "entry"` to the project file with no version rung. The PR argues this is additive, and that is defensible. It is still a forward-incompatible file for older builds, so it is a `feat` that waits for the cut.
- A hands-on GUI check (menus, drag, posted output) is still open, as the body says.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
